name: upload_file
description: Upload one file to the media host and get its public link. Give the file content as UTF-8 text in `content`, or as base64 in `content_base64` (exactly one of the two). `visibility` is private (link-capability: anyone with the URL), members (signed-in members only) or public (listed, embeddable). Returns id, url, sha256 of the stored bytes, size, content_type, visibility and created_at. Each call stores a new file with a new id.

name: get_file_meta
description: Get the metadata of one uploaded file by id: filename, url, sha256, size, content_type, visibility, created_at, and deleted_at when it was deleted. Never returns the content.

name: delete_file
description: Delete one uploaded file by id. Its URL stops serving. The id is not reused. This cannot be undone.
